# Murivest Auctions (auctions.murivest.com)

> Commercial property auction intelligence for Kenya and the United Kingdom,
> published by Murivest Group Ltd — a commercial real estate services firm
> providing brokerage, property and asset management, and investment property
> services across East Africa, the United Kingdom and international markets.
> Murivest Group Ltd is not an auctioneer, does not receive bids, does not
> hold deposits, and does not act as principal in any auction transaction.

## About

Murivest Group Ltd aggregates, verifies and presents commercial property
auction opportunities and routes qualified buyers to the appropriate
auctioneer, receiver or bank process. All engagements are by mandate only,
non-pooled, and subject to KYC/AML verification. The selling party named on
each listing is responsible for the auction process, the legal pack, and the
sale contract. Guide prices are not valuations.

## Markets

- Kenya (/kenya): bank sales, receiver sales, court-ordered sales and private
  treaty lots. Governed by the Land Act 2012 (ss. 90-97) and the Auctioneers
  Act (Cap 526). 25% deposit on the fall of the hammer (cash or banker's
  cheque), 75% balance within 90 days, stamp duty of 4% on urban properties.
- United Kingdom (/uk): commercial investment lots across London and regional
  UK. Governed by the RICS Common Auction Conditions (4th edition) and the
  Standard Commercial Property Conditions. 10% deposit on exchange, balance
  typically 20 working days later, unconditional contracts on the fall of the
  hammer.

## Content

- /auctions — all verified lots, filterable by market, region, asset type,
  status and price
- /calendar — upcoming auctions by date, market and auction house
- /how-auctions-work — buying, selling, legal pack and glossary guides
- /intelligence — market analysis and evergreen guides from Murivest Research
- /tools — free institutional-grade calculators: return (net yield,
  cash-on-cash, DSCR, levered IRR), underwriting gates, and loan repayment.
  All calculations run client-side; no data is stored.

## Listing facts

Each listing states the selling party, auction house, auction date, guide
price, tenure, legal pack status, a full property facts set (price, NOI,
gross rent where disclosed, building area, occupancy), derived investment
metrics (net yield, payback, ROI, GRM), jurisdiction-appropriate conditions
of sale, and a verification summary. Where gross annual rent is not disclosed
by the selling party, GRM is shown as "Not disclosed."

## Citation policy

Content on auctions.murivest.com may be cited with attribution to
"Murivest Group Ltd" and a link to the relevant page. Auction disclosure:
Murivest Group Ltd provides commercial real estate services and publishes
auction intelligence. Murivest is not the auctioneer, does not receive bids,
does not hold deposits, and does not act as principal in any auction
transaction. This information does not constitute an offer, solicitation, or
investment advice.
